capA_shading.approved: Alex 5 Nov 2026 (Cap A: plain cap, seams, button, shine, darker peak)
capA_shading.formula: bauble designer shade(hex,f): f<1 -> channel*f, f>1 -> channel+(255-channel)*(f-1), rounded; applied to the CAP colour only
capA_shading.flattened_shine: 1.175 / 1.21 / 1.42 = the approved cap shine (shade 1.25 / 1.3 / 1.6 drawn at 70% opacity over the cap) flattened to one solid colour: shade(cap, 1 + 0.7 x (f - 1)). Looks the same; the print file has no transparency (v4, 25 Nov).
